mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary policy easing, thereby boosting equity valuations via lower real rates and improved risk appetite over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average forward return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in residential construction permits below 1.05 million units over two consecutive months signals weakening household demand and reduced confidence in the housing market, which correlates with broader consumer spending slowdowns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling weakening economic momentum and reduced corporate profitability expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which increases the probability of a near-term recession and triggers risk-off behavior, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1050.0 and RSAFS < 435000.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are below threshold, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a sustained increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% annually signals a tightening monetary cycle amid persistent inflation, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (annualized) for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative average return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment growth below 50k and a rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals a labor market slowdown that reduces wage pressures and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, which boosts equity valuations via lower real rates and improved risk appetite over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth < 50.0 and UNRATE > 5.5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 435,000 million dollars combined with a drop in industrial production below 105.0 signals a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and triggering risk-off behavior, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 435000.0 and INDPRO < 105.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative average return (t-test p > 0.05).
